headline.text: L1 S4 broken gasket piece *not detectable* by metal detector — piece remains missing after investigation.

summary: Two active holds — spatula-in-mix on L1 S4 (scrapped), gasket fragment possibly in product (MD does not detect). L1 S3 nut found in MD bin from scraper guard; maintenance found multiple bolts/nuts improperly secured. L3 ML1 broken plastic nut from safety sensor replaced with zip tie.

holds.title: Spatula broken in caramel mix batch
holds.summary: Blade struck spatula during mixing at 09:41, broke it inside batch; batch and spatula scrapped per Hervin Herrera.
holds.status: Resolved — batch and spatula scrapped; team reminded not to place utensils in bowl during active mixing.

holds.title: 5 pallets incorrect lot code on one side of box
holds.summary: First shift coded boxes with correct lot on one side only; 5 pallets placed on rework, 2 at SV requested back for re-coding.
holds.status: On hold — 1st shift team scheduled to re-code all 5 pallets tomorrow morning; 2nd shift swapping cases from SV pallets.

food_safety.title: Broken gasket piece missing — MD does not detect
food_safety.summary: Valve gasket to Sucrotherm tore at 14:20; missing fragment not found in candy, drained water, or barrel; test piece passed through MD without rejection.
food_safety.status: Open — reserve drained and flushed, fragment not recovered; MD test at 17:42 showed material not detectable.

food_safety.title: Nut found in S3 metal detector bin
food_safety.summary: Rafael found nut in MD bin at 06:46, traced to scraper guard bolts; maintenance found several bolts/nuts not properly installed or secured on same guard.
food_safety.status: Resolved on shift — maintenance corrected all bolts/nuts on scraper guard and confirmed secure.

food_safety.title: S4 Theegarten knife set damaged — recurring
food_safety.summary: Knife fingers bent, film fold plate knocked out at 07:01; Chris Jeffs: 'We know the root cause. We are running too long and too high of caramel.'
food_safety.status: Open — maintenance repairing; root cause identified as caramel size out of spec for wrapper.

food_safety.title: Broken plastic nut from Cavanna safety sensor
food_safety.summary: Plastic nut securing safety door sensor broke during third shift; maintenance secured sensor with zip tie at 13:42.
food_safety.status: Open — sensor temporarily secured with zip tie; permanent repair pending.

quality.title: ML3 doubles/triples from hole in same piece every mold
quality.summary: Raymond Fleming found same chocolate piece with hole on every mold at 14:38, likely causing FW doubles/triples.
quality.status: Open — CIL performed at 14:30, depositor nozzles blown out; monitoring.

quality.title: Over 200 molds damaged on ML4
quality.summary: Itzel reported 200+ damaged molds in system at 06:32 after aligner programming issues and start/stops on first shift.
quality.status: Open — damaged molds being cycled out; aligner programming corrected by Stefan.

quality.title: Chocolate pallet label over different label
quality.summary: Grey Boscan flagged pallet at 08:39 with visible label underneath showing different number; assume original error led to re-labeling.
quality.status: Open — pallet flagged for verification; no further disposition posted.

sanitation.title: ML2 chocolate dripped on molds — operator error
sanitation.summary: Filler operator reloaded recipe as training example at 02:32, forgot to turn branch pump back on; depositor ran dry and dripped on majority of molds.
sanitation.status: Resolved on shift — all clean molds loaded, operators hand-cleaning affected molds while mold washer doors repaired.

sanitation.title: Caramel contamination in ML4 chocolate sweco
sanitation.summary: North sweco clogged at 02:43 with material tasting like caramel; traced to remelted chocolate from reject system; quick wash performed.
sanitation.status: Resolved — sweco washed and restarted at 04:21; Chad Stone directed stop all remelting until reject system validated for pure chocolate.

opportunities.title: Consider pre-startup inspection checklist for S4 Theegarten knife set and guide alignment — today's second knife damage event in 24h cited caramel size out of wrapper spec as root cause.
